notes: Locale participates in profile admission by invalidating the admission generation at the platform's locale-change entry point (iOS: runtime settings mutation + ProfileService.localeDidChange; Android: the service/facade setLocaleIdentifier), with a best-effort effective-locale comparison at each admission check.

Locale-scoped state: release authority, segment snapshot, cached/disk profile, the visible in-memory profile. Customer-scoped state is locale-INDEPENDENT and still commits from a response whose locale-scoped state was discarded: server facts, user properties, mailbox/journey work.
localeRoundTripDuringFetch pins the generation rule: even when the effective locale returns to the fetch's locale before the response lands, the old fetch stays invalidated.

A locale round trip (back to the fetch's locale before the response lands) discards the response wholesale: with the effective locale equal again, invalidation is indistinguishable from supersession by a newer fetch, and superseded responses contribute nothing. Customer-scoped payloads are durable server-side and redeliver on the replacement fetch.

cases.name: a response fetched under an old locale does not admit locale-scoped state
a locale round trip still rejects the old fetch
a disk profile from a different locale is rejected
a disk profile matching the effective locale hydrates
